name: IT pause-child child
description: Notes its start in counted.txt in the workspace, waits until the file go is there, and ends.

config.command: echo started >> "{{ project_path }}/counted.txt"; n=0; while [ ! -e "{{ project_path }}/go" ] && [ $n -lt 900 ]; do sleep 0.1; n=$((n + 1)); done; test -e "{{ project_path }}/go" && echo child done
